==== aboard init --harness codex --scope project ====
claude-code: not chosen
codex, in this project:
  create    ~/project/.agents/skills/aboard/SKILL.md (skill)
  create    ~/project/.codex/hooks.json (hooks)
            SessionStart: ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook codex session-start
            UserPromptSubmit: ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook codex prompt
            Stop: ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook codex stop
            PreToolUse: ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook codex tool
            SessionEnd: ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook codex end
Codex's sandbox blocks network access, so aboard commands Codex runs can't reach the local server; add --allow-commands to let Codex run them outside its sandbox.
Run aboard init --yes --scope project --harness codex to make these changes.
==== aboard init --yes --harness codex --scope project --json ====
{
  "applied": true,
  "scope": "project",
  "delivery": null,
  "allow_commands": false,
  "harnesses": [
    {
      "name": "claude-code",
      "detected": true,
      "changes": []
    },
    {
      "name": "codex",
      "detected": true,
      "changes": [
        {
          "path": "{HOME}/project/.agents/skills/aboard/SKILL.md",
          "kind": "skill",
          "action": "create"
        },
        {
          "path": "{HOME}/project/.codex/hooks.json",
          "kind": "hooks",
          "action": "create"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
==== aboard init --yes --harness codex --scope project (again) ====
claude-code: not chosen
codex, in this project:
  unchanged ~/project/.agents/skills/aboard/SKILL.md (skill)
  unchanged ~/project/.codex/hooks.json (hooks)
Codex's sandbox blocks network access, so aboard commands Codex runs can't reach the local server; add --allow-commands to let Codex run them outside its sandbox.
Nothing to change.
==== file project/.agents/skills/aboard/SKILL.md ====
(the Aboard skill this aboard installs, byte for byte)
==== file project/.codex/hooks.json ====
{
  "hooks": {
    "SessionStart": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook codex session-start",
            "timeout": 30
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "UserPromptSubmit": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook codex prompt",
            "timeout": 10
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "Stop": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook codex stop",
            "timeout": 10
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "PreToolUse": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook codex tool",
            "timeout": 30,
            "additionalContextLimit": 8192
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "SessionEnd": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook codex end",
            "timeout": 3
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
